data_fields.name: roster_remove_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: removed when seen with a non-party shield that is not ShieldNone; out-of-view members kept

best_idea: Refresh a roster with a leading run plus one trailing run per debounce window, so a burst of membership events costs at most two redraws.
decision_why: The debounce shape fits Frankendom, but the donor takes membership from visible shields and keeps out-of-view members; Frankendom needs the roster to come from the server (one ledger), so only the refresh shape is taken.
acceptance: A server test asserts that after a member leaves while out of view, the next roster snapshot removes that member; and a client test shows 5 join/leave events inside one 500 ms window cause at most 2 roster renders.
